superflowHeadline: BugHerd is a QA tool. Superflow is a QA tool + a team.
superflowBody: The team is AI agents, built from your QA checklist. They check every site change and pin what they find. Your team decides. Your client approves from a link.
superflowBestFor: agencies where a senior person still checks every site by hand.

entries.name: Marker.io
entries.bestFor: dev teams that live in a tracker.
entries.standout: capture into Jira, Linear, Asana, with technical metadata.
entries.limits: A person finds every issue. Screenshot-first, not a live-site overlay. A formal client approval gate: not yet verified. Pricing from $39 per month annual (July 2026).
entries.vsAnchor: deeper tracker integrations; screenshot-first, not on-page. Still a person finding every mistake.

entries.limits: Product feedback, not agency client review. Human-found only. Pricing: not yet verified.
entries.vsAnchor: adds user-feedback widgets BugHerd doesn't have. Less built for client site review.

entries.name: Pastel
entries.limits: Proxy-based review, not the live site: not yet verified. Light workflow. Human-found only. Pricing: not yet verified.

entries.name: Ruttl
entries.bestFor: the closest BugHerd-like experience on a budget.
entries.limits: Same premise: people find, the tool records. Full feature set and pricing: not yet verified.
entries.vsAnchor: the budget BugHerd. Similar pins, plus suggest-edits, lighter board: not yet verified.

stayHeading: The sixth option: stay on BugHerd
stayBody: Pins with browser and OS attached. Built-in kanban. Free guest links. Deep integrations, Jira and Trello included (verified July 2026).
stayLine: If a careful human pass works for your studio, stay.

faq.question: Which is the best BugHerd alternative?
faq.answer: Depends which criterion fails you. If it's the checking hours, Superflow, the only one where the answer is a team, not a tool.

faq.question: Is Superflow just BugHerd with AI?
faq.answer: No. Agents find the mistakes; a person makes every call.

faq.question: Can clients comment without an account?
faq.answer: On several, BugHerd included. In Superflow the client's yes is a recorded approval, not a comment.

faq.question: What does switching cost?
faq.answer: An afternoon. One snippet, or one click on Webflow, WordPress, GTM. Open projects finish where they are.
